name: print-social-esports-virtual-reality-classic-console-flyer-red-navy-diagonal
title: 'Virtual Reality or Classic Console?' esports flyer with a red-navy diagonal split and duotone controller photo
whatItIs: A square flyer split diagonally between white and red, with a red-duotone photo of a hand holding a game controller at top, a black-and-white photo of a man using VR controllers below, a bold navy 'Virtual Reality or Classic Console?' headline, a 'Play to win' tag and body copy.
whatItMeans: Punchy and on-topic; posing VR against classic consoles as a real question makes the flyer feel like part of the gaming conversation, not just an ad.
techniques: Split a layout diagonally between two contrasting fields.
Duotone one photo while keeping another in natural greyscale for contrast.
Frame the headline as a genuine question to the audience.

vocabulary.definition: A layout divided by an angled rather than straight line.
A headline phrased as a question to engage the reader.
